'''Skogres''' are skeletal ogres who have invaded the dance site of [[Jiggig]], south of [[Castle Wars]]. They have continued the dance that they did there in life during undeath and show no signs of stopping. They are encountered during the [[Zogre Flesh Eaters]] quest. Their name appears to be a portmanteau of "skeleton" and "ogre". They count as both [[Skeletons (Slayer assignment)|skeletons]] and [[Ogres (Slayer assignment)|ogres]] for [[Slayer assignments]].

An aggressive Skogre also has a chance to spawn next to the player when burying [[Zogre bones]] inside Jiggig.

==Strengths and weaknesses==
Skogres take heavily reduced damage from normal weapons (approximately 75% reduction). Like [[Zogres]], they are weak to [[brutal arrows]], taking full damage. They also take full damage from [[poison]] and [[Summoning familiars]]. [[Necromancy]] is very effective against Zogres.
